VBO:0200371.summary: Affectionate and quick to learn, seven-year-old Cockatzu Mimi was described by her owner as a devoted lap companion. This Shih Tzu–Cocker Spaniel cross had also developed a love for jumping, shown in her owner’s photographs of her clearing a small bar. Her story offers a personal glimpse of the cross, rather than a promise about every dog’s temperament or abilities.
VBO:0200371.shortDescription: A Shih Tzu–Cocker Spaniel cross; Mimi’s owner describes a loving lap companion, quick learner and enthusiastic jumper.
